title: Optimization of biological reactor capacity in a municipal wastewater treatment plant using GPS-X simulation under high nitrogen loads
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, 12,673-683
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW01008J, Paper
Chan Kwon Kim, Eun-Sik Kim
This study evaluates municipal WWTPs using the DNR process under high nitrogen loads. GPS-X simulation with ASM2d shows that a pre-anoxic upgrade with partial influent diversion improves nitrogen and phosphorus removal.
